{"code": "import re
pages=['page18','page19','page20']
raw_records=[]; current_group=None
for page in pages:
    o=tables['mmc1.pdf'][page]
    for ri,(row,g) in enumerate(zip(o['rows'],o['geometry']),start=1):
        if row and str(row[0])=='Osimertinib' and len(row)>1 and str(row[1])=='group': current_group='osimertinib'
        elif row and str(row[0])=='Other' and len(row)>2 and str(row[2])=='group': current_group='other_targeted'
        elif row and str(row[0])=='Dual' and len(row)>3 and str(row[3])=='group': current_group='dual_targeted'
        elif row and str(row[0])=='Chemotherapy' and len(row)>1 and str(row[1])=='group': current_group='chemotherapy'
        c1=str(row[0]) if row else ''; c2=str(row[1]) if len(row)>1 else ''
        m=re.fullmatch(r'(P-\d+)(P-\d+-[A-Z0-9]+)', c1)
        if m: case_id,organoid_id=m.groups()
        elif re.fullmatch(r'P-\d+-[A-Z0-9]+', c2): case_id,organoid_id=c1,c2
        else: continue
        def words_near(xlo,xhi): return [c for c in g['cells'] if xlo <= c['x0'] <= xhi]
        ic_text=' '.join(c['text'] for c in words_near(525,545))
        response_text=' '.join(c['text'] for c in words_near(560,580))
        ic_col=next(ci for ci,val in enumerate(row,start=1) if str(val)==ic_text)
        resp_col=next(ci for ci,val in enumerate(row,start=1) if str(val)==response_text)
        raw_records.append({'group':current_group,'page':page,'row':ri,'case':case_id,'organoid':organoid_id,
                            'ic_ref':cell_ref('mmc1.pdf',page,ri,ic_col),'truth_ref':cell_ref('mmc1.pdf',page,ri,resp_col),
                            'ic_text':ic_text,'response':response_text})
cutoffs={'osimertinib':2.14,'chemotherapy':20.9,'dual_targeted':1.32,'other_targeted':0.59}
def score_value(text):
    t=text.replace('(cid:893)','').strip()
    return float(t)
records=[]; cm={'TP':0,'FP':0,'FN':0,'TN':0}
for r in raw_records:
    cutoff=cutoffs[r['group']]; score=score_value(r['ic_text']); pred=1 if score<=cutoff else 0; truth=1 if r['response']=='PR' else 0
    if pred and truth: cm['TP']+=1
    elif pred and not truth: cm['FP']+=1
    elif not pred and truth: cm['FN']+=1
    else: cm['TN']+=1
    records.append({'id':'%s|%s|%s'%(r['case'],r['organoid'],r['group']),
                    'score':{'ref':r['ic_ref'],'threshold':cutoff,'op':'<=','regex':r'([0-9.]+(?:E\+\d+)?|1000)'},
                    'truth':{'ref':r['truth_ref'],'map':{'PR':1,'PD':0,'SD':0}}})
accuracy=(cm['TP']+cm['TN'])/len(records)
print('n=',len(records),'confusion=',cm,'accuracy=',accuracy)
assert len(records)==54 and cm=={'TP':21,'FP':5,'FN':4,'TN':24}
assert abs(accuracy-0.8333333333333334)<1e-12
fields={
 'unit':{'value':'organoid_line','evidence':['article:p35'],'explanation':'The denominator is 54 LCO drug-test comparisons derived from 36 patients, not 54 independent patients.'},

 'threshold_timing':{'value':'outcome_optimized','evidence':['article:p35','article:p102'],'explanation':'No independent or prespecified cutoff is reported; cut points were selected in this evaluated cohort, and the paper states precise cutoff values remain undefined.'},
 'patient_mapping':{'value':'individual_available','evidence':['mmc1.pdf/page18/R10C1','mmc1.pdf/page18/R10C2'],'explanation':'Each row has a case ID and a specific organoid ID; repeated organoids are separate analysis units.'},
 'regimen_match':{'value':'matched','evidence':['article:p35'],'explanation':'Only cases whose clinical regimens were identical to the tested LCO-DST regimen were included.'},
 'n_units':{'value':54,'evidence':['article:p35','supp.pdf/page4/R3C3'],'explanation':'Fifty-four matched LCO-regimen comparisons; the confusion matrix sums to 54.'},
 'split':{'value':'same_cohort','evidence':['article:p35','article:p102'],'explanation':'Real-world observational cohort with no separate held-out validation cohort.'}
}
CONTRACT={'status':'computed','fields':fields,'headline':{'metric':'accuracy','reported':0.8333333333333334,
 'reported_evidence':['article:p35','supp.pdf/page4/R3C3'],'threshold':None,'op':'==','score_direction':'higher','records':records,'blocked_reason':None},
 'notes':['Regimen-specific IC50 cut points: osimertinib 2.14 uM, chemotherapy 20.9 uM, dual-targeted therapy 1.32 uM, other targeted therapy 0.59 uM.',
          'Reconstructed matrix: Sensitive/PR=21, Sensitive/PD-or-SD=5, Resistant/PR=4, Resistant/PD-or-SD=24; accuracy=(21+24)/54=0.8333333.',
          'SD is treated as non-response in the binary clinical endpoint.']}
